name: Listen
description: A Listen button under the title of long pages. The page is read aloud with the visitor's own device voices, highlighting each paragraph. Nothing is sent anywhere.

panels.title: Listen
panels.description: A button that reads long pages aloud with the voices built into your visitor's phone or computer. It only shows when the device has a voice for the page's language. Changes show on your pages right away.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show a Listen button
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

fields.name: min-words
fields.title: Only on pages with at least this many words
fields.description: 250 words is about a minute and a half of listening.

fields.name: highlight
fields.title: Highlight the paragraph being read
fields.description: And keep it in view while reading.

fields.name: colour
fields.title: Button colour
fields.description: The text colour is chosen for you so it stays readable.

fields.name: language
fields.title: Language of the button
fields.description: The voice always follows the language of the page.

choices.title: Every page except those listed below

fields.name: page-list
fields.title: Page list
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: home, contact, blog/*. A * at the end means every page under it.
